summaries.en: Cordis is a TypeScript-first meta-framework for building modular Node.js applications, tackling the complexity of managing many plugins and services. Its core idea is spatiotemporal composability: plugins can be loaded or unloaded dynamically in any scope, and their lifecycles are fully controlled, making applications highly adaptable. Built around a lightweight dependency-injection core with effect-friendly integrations, it keeps projects tidy and reusable. You can use Cordis to create extensible bots, developer tools, or your own plugin architecture, separating concerns while enabling features to compose cleanly and behave predictably even in real-time environments.

summaries.en: Ornith-1.0-35B-GGUF is an open-weight 35B-parameter conversational model quantized to GGUF format, enabling efficient local execution on consumer hardware. It solves the practical problem of deploying large language models without expensive cloud GPUs while preserving useful conversational quality. Technically, GGUF quantization reduces memory footprint and speeds inference, making the model accessible via llama.cpp or similar runtimes. With MIT licensing and endpoint compatibility, it's ideal for prototyping chatbots, private AI assistants, or offline text-generation tools. Developers can easily download and run it locally, or integrate it into applications via standard inference servers.

summaries.en: Qwen3.6-27B-Fable-Fusion is a community fine-tune of Qwen3.6-27B, distributed as GGUF quantizations for efficient local inference. It combines abliteration to remove refusals, multi-stage tuning for nuanced creative writing, and multi-token prediction to speed up generation. This makes it a practical choice for roleplay, story generation, or unrestricted experimentation. You can run it with llama.cpp on consumer hardware, and adapt the quantized checkpoints for offline assistants or interactive fiction. Its strong reasoning and uncensored style offer a playground for advanced prompt engineering and character-driven AI applications.
